name: scenepilot-android
description: Android wrapper for the ScenePilot web UI (Capacitor). The web code in src/scenepilot/static is not changed; build-www.mjs copies it and adds the app-only files in native/.

scripts.sync: node build-www.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.run:phone: node build-www.mjs && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
